title: The Tale of Peter Rabbit
author: Beatrix Potter
summary: Disobedient young Peter Rabbit slips into Mr. McGregor's garden to eat vegetables, is chased by the farmer and loses his jacket. He escapes home, feels unwell and is put to bed with chamomile tea.
readIf: you want a gentle classic with small, detailed illustrations to read aloud to a young child.
skipIf: you want a longer story or a modern voice.
